Time-Dependent AUC from a Survival-Probability Matrix

Source: R/evaluation.R
auc_survmat.Rd

Computes a cumulative/dynamic time-dependent AUC using predicted survival probabilities at a specified time point (or the last column if t_star is NULL), following the Uno et al. (2007) / Heagerty and Zheng (2005) estimator as implemented in the timeROC package. Cases are subjects with an observed event strictly before t_star; controls are subjects known to survive beyond t_star. Subjects censored before t_star are handled through IPCW weighting.

Usage

auc_survmat(object, predicted, t_star = NULL)

Arguments

object

A Surv object of length \(n\).

predicted

An n x k matrix or data frame of survival probabilities with columns named "t=<time>".

t_star

Optional numeric time at which to evaluate AUC; if omitted, the rightmost column of predicted is used.

Value

A named numeric scalar: "auc".

Details

Risk scores are defined as 1 - S(t) at the chosen time. The AUC is computed over case-control pairs using inverse-probability-of-censoring weights for cases and partial credit (0.5) for ties.

Examples

y <- survival::Surv(time = veteran$time, event = veteran$status)
sp <- matrix(
  stats::plogis(scale(veteran$karno)),
  ncol = 1,
  dimnames = list(NULL, "t=100")
)
auc_survmat(y, predicted = sp, t_star = 100)
#>      auc 
#> 0.795944
